counts: 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze. 28 are hidden on PlayStation until earned.
list: The official 55 trophies, as published before this guide was written (2026-11-18). Names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's own words; the guides are ours, written from those descriptions.

sources.exophase: Exophase — official trophy list (name, description, grade, hidden flag): https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/
sources.own: Our own advice, written from the official description. The game launched 19 Nov 2026, so steps that no official description pins down are marked not yet checked in the game — we claim nothing we have not verified.
sources.psnprofiles: PSNProfiles — PSN progress targets and counts: https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi

trophies.guide: The platinum pops on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. Work the roadmap in order (story, then strangers, then collectibles, then the grinds) and use the Next Up planner here to see what is left. Do the missable-flagged trophies as their chance comes up, so nothing is left to replay at the end.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing — it is the first story mission, so this is the first trophy most players earn. Follow the on-screen prompts; a story mission trophy cannot be missed, and it unlocks as soon as the mission ends.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies come from the story alone, so just keep playing the main missions in order — nothing here can be missed, and the trophy pops when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Like every chapter trophy, it comes from playing the story through — no side content is needed for it, and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. Keep following the main story; the trophy pops when the chapter ends. If a mission feels stuck, the in-game prompts show the next objective — chapter trophies never need a guide step of their own.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it works like the others: complete the story missions in order and it unlocks when the chapter closes.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission. It is a gold trophy because it marks the end of the story, not because it is hard to find — play through Chapter 4 and the finale unlocks. The mission name itself is a spoiler, so this guide hides it until you earn it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run when it appears in the mission flow. Mission trophies cannot be missed — if you play the story, you will reach it — so just follow the mission markers when it opens up.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in the story are set pieces with their own setup, so take the prep steps the game offers and then run the heist itself — the trophy pops at the mission's end.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. It arrives through the normal mission flow, so there is nothing to unlock first beyond reaching its point in the story.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. As with every mission trophy, the only requirement is finishing that mission — play the story in order and it comes to you.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set around Vice City International Airport. Follow the mission markers; the trophy unlocks when the takedown is done.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It is a late-story mission trophy, so it comes naturally if you keep playing the main missions — nothing about it can be missed.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: Reach 100% in the game's own completion counter — the gold trophy for doing everything, not just the story. That means story plus stranger strands, activities, collectibles and the counted grinds (stunts, challenges, races). Track it in the game's stats screen and use this guide's checklist to find the gaps; leave the long counts (250 stunts, 50 challenges) for the cleanup stage, when the whole map is open.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts across Leonida — jumps, airtime, near-misses and similar driving feats all feed the same counter, and the count carries across the whole game. The fastest way is to chain stunts in free roam: find a ramp or jump, land it, and keep moving. There is no time limit and no single spot required, so let the total build up naturally while you play, then grind the remainder in free roam at the end.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types in the game at least once — fishing, races, the shooting range, arcade games, bowling, meditation, drone races, and the rest of the leisure activities Leonida offers. You do not need to win or finish anything, just sample each one, so work through the activities as you meet them in the world and this pops early. The exact list of 9 is the game's own activity menu; if one type is unclear, the activities map in-game shows what is available.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Each challenge is a short timed shooting trial, and gold means beating its target score — repeatable as many times as you like, so a failed run costs nothing. Take them one range at a time, learn each challenge's layout before going for gold, and use the weapon the challenge gives you rather than switching mid-run. 42 is a long grind, so spread it across the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are short courses — learn the gates on a practice run, then race for the win; each location counts separately, so you must win at every one. They are repeatable, so a loss just means racing that location again.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not 20 wins of the same one. Leonida's races are spread across the map, so try a new race each time rather than repeating a favourite. Wins in different race types all count, and races can be retried freely.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Cal is a fishing rival you meet through the fishing activity — take the challenge when it is offered and out-fish him. If you lose, challenge him again; the trophy is for the win, not for a first try.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game at an arcade in Leonida. Any arcade game counts, so pick the shortest one you enjoy and play it through to its end — a single completed game is all it takes.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Contact strands build up mission by mission — keep taking Andy's missions as they appear and the finale unlocks. The final mission's name is hidden here until you earn it, to keep the story unspoiled.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Take Kenton's missions as they come up in the world and the strand ends with this trophy. Like the other contact finales, it cannot be missed — the strand stays available until you finish it.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Keep accepting Billy's missions when they appear; the strand's finale is the trophy, and it waits for you — there is no deadline on contact missions.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 full stranger mission strands — the Strangers & Freaks-style side missions scattered across Leonida. Each strand is a small chain of missions for one stranger; finish all of one person's chain and it counts as one strand. Watch for stranger markers on the map as you explore, and do a strand when you find it rather than leaving them all for the end. 8 strands is the silver — the five named contacts (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are five of them.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Randy's missions appear as you play; take them when offered and the strand ends with this trophy.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Tyrone's chain is one of the stranger strands, so it also counts toward the 8-strand silver — do it as part of the stranger sweep, not as a separate trip.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic places — the game marks them when you are near, and each one you use counts. Work through them as you explore new areas rather than hunting all 18 in one trip; the count carries across the whole game.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the one unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunt is a stranger strand: take his missions until he names the animal, then track it down. The official description does not pin down which animal or where it roams, so this step is not yet checked in the game — follow Bret's own directions in his missions and the hunt itself will point you at the target.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are hidden around Leonida — pick them up as you find them, and a set completes when you hold every card in it. You need 3 finished sets, not every card in the game, so focus on the sets you are closest to finishing and trade the search for the last few cards of a set against starting a new one. No card is missable: they stay where they are until collected.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. Each location counts once, so keep moving — revisiting the same spot does not add to the total. The counter carries across the whole game, so let it build up as you explore and mop up the last locations during the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges — the game's own challenge list, covering driving, combat, exploration and activities. Challenges tick off as you play, and many overlap with other trophies (stunts, races, collectibles), so a good share of the 50 will already be done by the time you finish the story. Check the challenge list in-game to see which kinds you are short on, then target those.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Do it on your own terms: pick a quiet stretch of road away from the city centre, raise the heat with your partner in the car, then break line of sight and hide until the stars clear. It is retryable — a failed escape just means raising the heat again — but it needs your partner with you, so do not attempt it solo. Flagged as easy to miss only because the setup is specific.
trophies.missableNote: Needs your partner with you and a 4-star wanted level. Retryable, but the setup is specific — do it when the chance comes.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row — one after another, without losing your wanted level between them. Plan the route first: pick 3 shops close together, keep the getaway car ready, and move fast so the heat never drops. If the wanted level clears, the chain breaks and you start over — that is why this is flagged. Retryable, but the chain is the hard part.
trophies.missableNote: The 3 robberies must chain without the wanted level clearing. Plan 3 nearby shops first.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride a vehicle and it counts as discovered. Leonida is full of variety, so the total climbs fast if you try a new vehicle whenever you see one instead of sticking to the same car. The count carries across the whole game; mop up the last few in free roam by driving through different districts.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Set it up: find a spot with at least 5 enemies close together, trigger Combat Focus, and work through them before it ends. If you only get 4, the attempt fails and you try again — the trophy is for one clean run, which is why it is flagged. Pick a busy fight rather than a quiet one.
trophies.missableNote: All 5 takedowns must land inside one Combat Focus use. Pick a fight with 5+ enemies grouped together.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Leave Vice City International Airport in a way the airport did not schedule — take a plane (or another way out) without a ticket or a flight plan, and get clear of the airport. The official description does not pin down the exact method, so this step is not yet checked in the game: the natural reading is to steal an aircraft at VCIA and fly out. Expect a wanted level; fly low and fast once you are up.
trophies.missableNote: A one-off stunt at the airport. The exact method is not pinned down by the official description — flagged because it is a single specific act.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhinos — the tanks. The description is a joke, not a checklist, and it does not pin down what counts: the natural reading is to take on (or take over) a Rhino tank. This step is not yet checked in the game, so treat it as a combat encounter to find in free roam or a mission — look for military hardware and engage it, and the trophy will tell you when it lands.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store and stay undetected from start to finish — no alarm, no witness raising it. Case the store first, go in quiet, take the goods and leave before anyone notices. If you are spotted, the attempt fails and you retry the robbery; that is why it is flagged. A stealthy approach and a fast exit matter more than speed inside.
trophies.missableNote: One clean, undetected robbery. Being spotted fails the attempt — retry until it is clean.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the entry, crack the vault, and get clear before the response arrives. Each vault counts separately and the total carries across the game, so there is no rush — do one when you are ready, escape cleanly, and move on to the next.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash and get clear before the response catches you. A fast car and a planned escape route make it simple; if it goes wrong, another truck will come along.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida — the whole map, from Vice City to the far corners of the state. Areas count as explored when you enter them, so this is a long drive, not a puzzle: use the map to find the areas you have not visited and sweep through them in the cleanup stage. It pairs well with the WAiNK and meditation counts, which are also spread across the map.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run spots on the map — hit one per gang, all 9. The count is per gang, so keep a note of which gangs you have done (this guide's notes field is made for exactly that) and sweep the remaining ones in the cleanup stage.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach. Head to the beachfront bars on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view — the trophy is for the moment, not a challenge. Any beachfront bar with a view should do; the description does not name a specific venue, so this step is not yet checked in the game.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive through a vehicle showroom's frontage and smash your way out — the classic GTA showroom exit. Pick a showroom, build speed, and go straight through the glass. It is a single stunt, retryable if the car gives up first, so bring a sturdy vehicle.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and follow through — play a game there to the end. The alley is a named location in Vice City; head there, start a game, and finish it. The exact requirement beyond playing is not pinned down by the description, so this step is not yet checked in the game — a full game is the safe reading.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Build a partnership with mass appeal — the description is deliberately vague, and it does not pin down what counts. The likely reading is a partner-activity moment (a shared activity or a social-media moment with your partner) that the game tracks. This step is not yet checked in the game: play partner activities as they come up, and the trophy will land when the partnership hits the mark the game wants.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make choices — PSN tracks this one toward a count of 500. Choices happen across the story, stranger missions and free-roam moments, so the total builds as you play; there is no single choice to find. Keep playing through story and side content and the count climbs on its own. If it is the last trophy left, replay choice-heavy missions and stranger strands.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description says it all: fail something, then succeed at it the second time. The official list does not say what the something is, so this step is not yet checked in the game. The natural reading is a failed-then-passed attempt at a mission, challenge or activity; play normally, and when you fail anything, retry it at once — the retry is the trophy.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — an easter egg or a random odd event somewhere in Leonida. The description is a wink, not directions: it does not say where or what. This step is not yet checked in the game. Explore the map's odd corners, watch for unusual encounters, and the trophy pops when the strange thing happens to you.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — strike from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Set it up on a quiet road: get speed, line up a target on foot, and swing as you pass. If the hit misses, circle back and try again — it is retryable, but it needs the hit to land from the vehicle, which is why it is flagged.
trophies.missableNote: The takedown must be a melee hit from a moving vehicle. Line up a target on a quiet road and retry until it lands.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts wash them into clean cash, and the total counts toward $250,000. Keep laundering after every big score instead of sitting on dirty money, and the total builds across the whole game.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. The total counts every shop in the game, so just play and buy what you need; big purchases (vehicles, weapons, properties) move it fast. If it is the last one left, buy and sell high-value items to push the total over the line.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are bought with clean cash, so save up — and launder Marked Bills first if you need clean money. Each garage also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover, so buy them as you explore new districts rather than all at once.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles around Leonida, then register them through the app — each new registration counts, and 10 is the target. Pair this with discovering 100 vehicles: every new vehicle you find is a candidate to register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
